note.title: Accuracy repair
note.overview: This lesson contains 50 enabled questions. It teaches Accuracy repair through explicit translation, recall, grammar and application tasks.
learningGoals: Recall the core language for Accuracy repair.
Identify the task direction before writing.
Explain errors by naming the article, subject, tense, auxiliary, agreement or negative rule.
Use the material in a short controlled sentence.
mustMemoriseRules: Use et in 71 and the learned hyphen pattern.
Gymnase is masculine: un grand gymnase.
An opinion needs a complete reason.
A real sentence needs its own capital letter and full stop.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the source example for this target: 70-99 numbers.
workedExamples.why: Use et in 71; use hyphens in compound numbers.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the source example for this target: Gender agreement.
Write the source example for this target: préférer + infinitive.
workedExamples.why: Conjugate préférer, then keep the second verb infinitive.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the source example for this target: Opinion + reason.
workedExamples.answer: J’aime la musique parce que c’est relaxant.
workedExamples.why: Answer Pourquoi…? with parce que + a full reason.

workedExamples.prompt: Write the source example for this target: Noun vs infinitive.
workedExamples.answer: J’aime le tennis. / J’aime jouer au tennis.
workedExamples.why: Use an article before a noun; no article before the infinitive.

commonMistakes: Conjugating the second verb after préférer.
A small article or ending can change the grammar even when the main vocabulary is recognisable.
Do not change a correct answer into an error just because the learner also wrote the subject.
